home.name: Dr. Shajini
home.title: Paediatric Surgeon & Paediatric Urologist
home.tagline: Gentle, precise surgical care for children — from newborns to teens.
home.bio: Dr. Shajini is a paediatric surgeon and paediatric urologist specialising in reconstructive urology, neonatal surgery, and minimally invasive paediatric procedures. She trained at Madras Medical College and Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education & Research, Chennai, and is committed to combining clinical precision with a calm, family-centred approach to every child's care.
qualifications: Fellowship in Paediatric Urology (2025–2026), Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education & Research, Chennai
M.Ch. Paediatric Surgery (2021–2024), Madras Medical College, Chennai — University Gold Medalist, Best Outgoing Student
MS General Surgery Residency (2018–2021), Madras Medical College, Chennai

treatments.title: General Paediatric Surgical Conditions
treatments.detail: Appendicitis, intussusception, gallstones, biliary atresia, choledochal cyst, empyema

treatments.title: Newborn Conditions
treatments.detail: Intestinal atresia, tracheo-oesophageal fistula, congenital diaphragmatic hernia, absent anus
